mapping.draft_py:
# Pyroclastic Elemental (M20). "{1}{R}{R}: This creature deals 1 damage to target player."
# The cost and the atom follow Chandra's Magmutt / Flamewave Invoker (B3-deal-dmg-const-player-or-
# planeswalker); the target is a player only, the PLAYER-zone TARGET selector that "target
# opponent" uses (templates_b2b._target_opponent) with controller ANY: any player (CR 115.1).
dmg = ActivatedAbility(
    cost=Cost(
        parts=(
            CostManaColor(color='R', amount=QConst(value=1)),
            CostManaColor(color='R', amount=QConst(value=1)),
            CostManaGeneric(amount=QConst(value=1)),
        ),
    ),
    effect=A(Verb.DEAL_DAMAGE, {
        'amount': QConst(value=1),
        'target': Selector(
            count=QConst(value=1),
            mode=SelectorMode.TARGET,
            filter=FAnd(children=()),
            zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.PLAYER, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
        ),
    }),
)
abilities = [dmg, *compiled]

clauses.clause: {1}{R}{R}: This creature deals 1 damage to target player.
